name: @equin/plugin-packages-blocking-write
description: writeAllSync(fd, data): every byte written before it returns, on a blocking or a NON-blocking fd alike — a full non-blocking pipe (EAGAIN) is waited out with poll(2) until the reader drains it, never spun on, dropped or swallowed. Bun turns a piped stdout non-blocking the first time process.stdout is touched, so a synchronous writer to fd 1 or 2 (`./equin build | tail`) must use this, not a bare writeSync.
